lines: With relation whose self is difference-and-non-difference, proving all things —
whose work is world-traffic — him, Śiva, of own will we sing.
sanskrit_cite: bhedābhedātmasaṃbandhasahasarvārthasādhitā lokayātrā kṛtiryasya svecchayā taṃ stumaḥ śivam

lines: Dawning in a body built of relation — being, difference, and the rest —
one, yet conquering: world-self, light, supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvabhedādisaṃbandhamayena vapuṣonmiṣan jayatyeko'pi viśvātmā prakāśaḥ parameśvaraḥ
notes: line 1 participial setup (vapuṣonmiṣan), spine carried by line 2

lines: Awaiting, dependence — no relation for the two inert ones:
ruled out. Win selfhood or not — metaphor, never definition.
sanskrit_cite: apekṣā pāratantryaṃ ca na saṃbandho jaḍātmanoḥ asaṃbhavādātmalābhe'pyupacāro na lakṣaṇā
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA

lines: If non-beings gain selfhood, two-seatedness too is dropped:
form-fusion alone stands — relation's stated sense.
sanskrit_cite: asatāmātmalābhokterdviṣṭhataivaṃ ca hīyate rūpasaṃśleṣa evaivaṃ saṃbandhārthaḥ sthitaḥ sa ca

lines: Not unbroken nearness — it misses relation: were it so,
So fusion of the many's form: that alone, one-selfhood.
notes: both lines nominal, mirroring verbless SA

lines: None barred from the many in one's own oneness — so others plead:
unmixed in themselves, things — thought alone conjoins them.
sanskrit_cite: naikasyaikye'pyanekasya bādha āhuryathā pare ityamiśrāḥ svayaṃ bhāvāstānyojayati kalpanā
notes: line 1 nominal, mirroring verbless SA; SP 5cd witness (Jha; MacCracken)

lines: No mere thought, this — it cannot be dismissed:
like snake-error, clinging to a shining, past remedy.
Clinging to a shining is no thing like a shining —
only trailing after shining: error, a shining astray.
sanskrit_cite: yasmādābhāsalagnatvaṃ nābhāsasadṛśārthatā kiṃ tvābhāsānusāritvaṃ bhrānta ābhāsa eva tat

lines: So even in this shining, the many's unity-seeing finds warrant —
statable too, told plain on recognition's path.
sanskrit_cite: itthamābhāsa evāsminnanekasyaikatādṛśi vācyopapattiḥ sāpyuktā pratyabhijñānaye sphuṭam
